messages:
maria: Heads-up: ran the nightly docs health job against content/runtime and content/guides. Results: 9 broken anchors, 2 external 403s (S3/gist), 1 frontmatter slug with leading whitespace. Short on cycles this sprint 914 who can take quick fixes?
jin: I can grab some anchors. Paste the output?
maria: Dropping sample lines below: 
- content/runtime/kv-cache.md: link to [See KV cache](#kv-cache-behavior )
- content/guides/onboarding.md: image -> https://gist.githubusercontent.com/_old/image.png (403)
- content/runtime/guide.md: slug: " runtime-guide"
docscan-bot: docs-scan v2.1.0; run_id=2026-03-23-07:22Z; dead_anchors=9; externals=2(HTTP403); frontmatter_trim_needed=1
ash: I'll take the two externals and rehost to our staging CDN. @leo can you help with the CDN path and short TTL?
leo: Use https://cdn.redwood-inference.internal/pub/docs/temp/ with TTL 7d. Will add an infra note in the PR about ACLs.
jin: I'll pick 4 anchors (mostly heading ID mismatches). Quick plan: convert fragile fragment links to explicit section IDs and leave comment in PR explaining why. ETA today afternoon.
maria: thanks. For the slug: trivial sed fix: 
```
# from repo root
perl -pi -e "s/^slug:\s*\"\s+(.*)\"/slug: \"\1\"/" content/runtime/guide.md
git commit -m "fix(docs): trim leading whitespace in runtime-guide slug"
```
ash: For my rehost PR I'll include a mapping table in the description: original_url -> cdn_url and note the cache control. I'll mark PR as "docs: rehost externals".
leo: Also +1 on adding a lint rule in docs CI: fail when frontmatter slug contains whitespace at ends. Small GH action would catch this early.
maria: I'm happy to open the CI PR after these merges unless someone wants to own it. It's tiny (bash check over frontmatter).
jin: If you open it, tag me for review. I'll land it after a quick pass.
ash: PRs coming: I'll open "fix(docs): rehost gist images to CDN" later tonight; jin will open anchors PRs; maria will do the slug + follow-up CI.
leo: Re-scan request: ping me here after merges and I'll queue a re-run tomorrow morning.
maria: Great. Split assignment idea: jin 4, maria 2 (slug+CI), ash 2 (externals), leo 1 review. Sound good?
jin: Works for me.
ash: Good plan. I'll post PR link when ready.
docscan-bot: noted. scheduled re-scan after PR merges (window: 24h).
maria: thanks everyone, leaving this thread open for PR links and quick CR pings.
notes: nightly docs scan; broken anchors and externals; slug leading space; rehost plan; CI lint suggestion; assignments and PR ownership noted
